mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.transfer_id, i.product_id, i.sku_id, i.quantity, i.out_quantity, i.receive_quantity, i.cost_price, i.amount, pr.product_name AS productName, pr.product_code AS productCode, sk.spec_text AS specText, (ai.stock - ai.locked_stock) AS availableStock FROM shop_erp_inventory_transfer_item i LEFT JOIN shop_product_sku sk ON sk.id = i.sku_id AND sk.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_product pr ON pr.id = sk.product_id AND pr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_inventory ai ON ai.sku_id = i.sku_id AND ai.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND ai.is_deleted = 0 WHERE i.transfer_id = #{transferId} AND i.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY i.id ASC
